**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

§ 24 satisfies the ASSIGN rule at the **preferred** position on every material term:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all/substantially all assets (notice-only, with assignee assumption).
- **24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — Residual assignments run on a mutual reasonable-consent standard.
- **24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service; Vendor must cooperate with successor administrative changes.

Cross-checks found no conflicting language: § 13 (p0056) confirms licence rights transfer to an Affiliate or successor under a § 24-permitted assignment, § 30.5 recognizes permitted successors as enforcing parties, and the only other "assignment" references are insolvency (§ 9) and IP assignment (§ 14) — neither creates a change-of-control exit or re-pricing right for Vendor.
